incidents.title: Gateway 5xx spike — upstream timeouts to ledger
incidents.description: p99 latency above 2500 ms and 5xx rate at 24% in eu-west-1; upstream connections to ledger time out and retries amplify load.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Connection pool to ledger exhausted after a deploy halved pool size. Resolved by: roll back the pool-size change; raise max connections to 310; drain and restart gateway pods in eu-west-1; watch p99 for 15 minutes.

incidents.title: Legitimate traffic throttled — rate limiter misconfigured
incidents.description: 429s at 89% for authenticated users in ap-southeast-1 after config push; abuse dashboard shows no attack traffic.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Per-IP limit applied to shared NAT ranges by a config typo. Resolved by: revert limiter config; exempt known NAT ranges; add config lint rule; backfill request credits for affected accounts.

incidents.title: TLS handshake failures at the edge — certificate expired
incidents.description: handshake failures climbing to 24% in ap-southeast-1; clients report certificate-expired errors on api.orbital.dev.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Automated renewal job lost its DNS challenge permission. Resolved by: issue certificate manually; restore renewal job credentials; add expiry alert at 21 days; verify full chain on all edge nodes.

incidents.title: Elevated 404s after canary — route table drift
incidents.description: 404 rate up 88% on /v2 endpoints in us-east-1 after canary promotion; old routes missing from the generated table.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Route generator ran against a stale service registry snapshot. Resolved by: re-run route generation from live registry; promote corrected table; add route-count diff check to canary gate.

incidents.title: Memory climb on gateway nodes — websocket connections never closed
incidents.description: gateway RSS grows 38% per hour; websocket count monotonic; nodes in us-east-1 OOM-restart roughly every 17 hours.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Idle-timeout handler dropped by a refactor, sockets leak. Resolved by: deploy idle-timeout fix; force-close sockets idle beyond 10 min; add websocket-count alert; verify memory plateau over 17 hours.

incidents.title: Login latency breach — password hash cost misconfigured
incidents.description: login p99 at 1200 ms in ap-southeast-1 after security patch; CPU saturated on auth pods; no traffic increase.

incidents.title: Users logged out en masse — session store eviction
incidents.description: active sessions dropped 36% in minutes; session store memory ceiling hit and LRU evicted live sessions in eu-west-1.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Session TTL doubled without resizing the store. Resolved by: raise store memory to 13 GB; restore TTL; move eviction policy to expire-only; page on 80% store memory.

incidents.title: Third-party OIDC provider outage — social logins failing
incidents.description: social login success below 38%; provider status page red; password logins unaffected in ap-southeast-1.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Upstream identity provider outage; no local fallback messaging. Resolved by: enable provider-outage banner; extend session lifetimes 31 hours during outage; add provider health probe to status page.

incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: NTP daemon dead on two hosts after base image update. Resolved by: restart and pin ntp service; raise skew tolerance to 30 s; alert on drift over 5 s; rebuild affected hosts.

incidents.description: webhook processing p99 at 2500 ms; provider retry queue depth 1300 and rising; duplicate delivery warnings in ap-southeast-1.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Webhook handler took a synchronous dependency on the ledger; ledger connection pool exhausted under load. Resolved by: roll back the pool-size change on ledger; make webhook ack async; drain retry queue; verify duplicate suppression on replay.

incidents.title: Nightly invoice job stalled — lock contention
incidents.description: invoice batch at 86% after 13 hours; lock waits dominate; no invoices issued for eu-west-1 accounts since midnight.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Batch job and API wrote the same account rows in opposite order. Resolved by: kill and restart batch with account-id ordering; chunk commits to 500 rows; schedule batch off-peak; add job progress alert at 2 h.

incidents.title: Card declines spiking — PSP degradation
incidents.description: decline rate 69% versus 4% baseline in eu-west-1; PSP latency 250 ms; declines cluster on one card network.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Payment service provider incident on one card network route. Resolved by: fail over to secondary PSP for the affected network; queue and auto-retry declined charges after recovery; notify affected merchants.

incidents.title: Duplicate charges reported — idempotency key regression
incidents.description: 22 duplicate-charge reports in eu-west-1; charge attempts show same cart charged twice within 1200 ms; idempotency table misses rising.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Idempotency key derivation changed, old retries no longer matched. Resolved by: restore previous key derivation; refund duplicates via script; backfill key mapping for in-flight retries; add dual-read during migrations.

incidents.title: Ledger imbalance — currency rounding drift
incidents.description: end-of-day ledger off by 12 cents per 10k transactions in us-east-1; drift began after FX precision change.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Mixed bankers-rounding and truncation across two code paths. Resolved by: standardize on bankers rounding in the shared money lib; replay affected batches; add reconciliation invariant test to CI.

incidents.title: Search results stale — indexing pipeline lag
incidents.description: index lag 25 minutes versus 2-minute SLO; new listings absent from results in eu-west-1; consumer group rebalancing repeatedly.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Indexer poll loop exceeded max-poll-interval on oversized batches. Resolved by: cap batch size at 2500 docs; raise max poll interval; replay backlog; alert on lag over 5 minutes.

incidents.title: Query latency uneven — shard hotspot
incidents.description: one shard at 55% CPU while others idle; p99 1200 ms for queries hitting tenant prefix in us-east-1.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Routing key concentrated one large tenant on a single shard. Resolved by: split hot tenant across 33 shards with composite routing; warm replicas before cutover; add per-shard CPU skew alert.

incidents.title: Faceted queries slow — planner regression after upgrade
incidents.description: facet-heavy queries p99 2500 ms post-upgrade in ap-southeast-1; plans switched to full scans on the category field.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Engine upgrade changed cost model; stats not rebuilt. Resolved by: rebuild field statistics; pin planner hints on top 20 facet queries; add plan-diff check to upgrade runbook.

incidents.title: Relevance complaints — synonym pack overreach
incidents.description: click-through on top-3 results down 55% in ap-southeast-1 after synonym deploy; unrelated products matching brand terms.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Overbroad synonym expansion mapped brand names to generic terms. Resolved by: roll back synonym pack; add offline relevance eval gate with 1400 golden queries; re-ship curated pack behind experiment flag.

incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: No circuit breaker on bucket count for scripted aggregations. Resolved by: set max-buckets circuit breaker; move analytics client to async export API; add per-client resource quota; restart affected nodes.

incidents.title: Transaction retries spiking — serialization conflicts
incidents.description: SQLSTATE 40001 retry rate 63% on orders workload in eu-west-1; p99 commit 2500 ms; contention on a counter row.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: New feature incremented a single global counter row per order. Resolved by: shard the counter into 21 buckets; keep client retry with backoff; add contention dashboard; verify 40001 rate under 1%.

incidents.title: Single range saturated — sequential key hotspot
incidents.description: one range at 25% CPU with sequential inserts in ap-southeast-1; write p99 800 ms; neighbors idle.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Monotonic key prefix concentrated writes on one range. Resolved by: switch to hash-sharded index with 23 buckets; pre-split ranges; confirm load spreads across nodes.

incidents.title: Node disk pressure — compactions falling behind
incidents.description: node storage at 14%; compaction backlog 32 GB; write stalls of 2500 ms appearing in ap-southeast-1.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: TTL job deleted heavily, tombstones outpaced compaction. Resolved by: throttle TTL deletes; raise compaction concurrency; add disk headroom alert at 70%; verify stall count returns to zero.

incidents.title: Nightly backup saturating IO — foreground latency breach
incidents.description: backup window overlaps peak; read p99 250 ms in us-east-1; disk throughput 52% consumed by backup streams.
incidents.resolution_summary: Root cause: Backup schedule drifted into regional peak after DST change. Resolved by: reschedule backup off-peak; cap backup IO priority; stagger by 5-minute offsets per node; alert on p99 during backup window.

runbooks.title: Runbook: Upstream timeout triage
runbooks.content: Applies to: Gateway 5xx spike — upstream timeouts to ledger. Typical cause: Connection pool to ledger exhausted after a deploy halved pool size. Steps: roll back the pool-size change; raise max connections to 190; drain and restart gateway pods in ap-southeast-1; watch p99 for 15 minutes. Escalate if symptoms persist 30 minutes after step completion.

runbooks.title: Runbook: Edge certificate incident response
runbooks.content: Applies to: TLS handshake failures at the edge — certificate expired. Typical cause: Automated renewal job lost its DNS challenge permission. Steps: issue certificate manually; restore renewal job credentials; add expiry alert at 21 days; verify full chain on all edge nodes. Escalate if symptoms persist 30 minutes after step completion.

runbooks.title: Runbook: Token validation failure triage
runbooks.content: Applies to: Token refresh loop — clients hammering /token. Typical cause: Token audience claim changed while validators kept the old value. Steps: roll back issuer audience change; purge bad tokens; coordinate validator config with issuer release; add audience contract test. Escalate if symptoms persist 30 minutes after step completion.

runbooks.title: Runbook: Auth latency runaway response
runbooks.content: Applies to: Login latency breach — password hash cost misconfigured. Typical cause: Patch bumped bcrypt cost factor from 10 to 14 in one env only. Steps: set cost factor back to 10; scale auth pool to 36 pods while backlog drains; add latency budget test to the patch pipeline. Escalate if symptoms persist 30 minutes after step completion.

runbooks.title: Runbook: Webhook backlog recovery
runbooks.content: Applies to: Payment webhooks timing out — provider retries piling up. Typical cause: Webhook handler took a synchronous dependency on the ledger; ledger connection pool exhausted under load. Steps: roll back the pool-size change on ledger; make webhook ack async; drain retry queue; verify duplicate suppression on replay. Escalate if symptoms persist 30 minutes after step completion.

runbooks.title: Runbook: Payment provider degradation playbook
runbooks.content: Applies to: Card declines spiking — PSP degradation. Typical cause: Payment service provider incident on one card network route. Steps: fail over to secondary PSP for the affected network; queue and auto-retry declined charges after recovery; notify affected merchants. Escalate if symptoms persist 30 minutes after step completion.

runbooks.title: Runbook: Indexing lag recovery
runbooks.content: Applies to: Search results stale — indexing pipeline lag. Typical cause: Indexer poll loop exceeded max-poll-interval on oversized batches. Steps: cap batch size at 3400 docs; raise max poll interval; replay backlog; alert on lag over 5 minutes. Escalate if symptoms persist 30 minutes after step completion.

runbooks.title: Runbook: Hot shard mitigation
runbooks.content: Applies to: Query latency uneven — shard hotspot. Typical cause: Routing key concentrated one large tenant on a single shard. Steps: split hot tenant across 11 shards with composite routing; warm replicas before cutover; add per-shard CPU skew alert. Escalate if symptoms persist 30 minutes after step completion.

runbooks.title: Runbook: Delivery backlog drain
runbooks.content: Applies to: Email delivery delayed — queue backlog. Typical cause: Relay IP reputation dip caused throttling; retries compounded. Steps: warm up secondary relay IPs; shed marketing traffic; drain backlog oldest-first; add deferral-rate alert at 5%. Escalate if symptoms persist 30 minutes after step completion.

runbooks.title: Runbook: Push credential expiry response
runbooks.content: Applies to: iOS pushes failing — APNs certificate expired. Typical cause: APNs auth key rotated in staging but not production. Steps: deploy renewed APNs key; replay failed pushes from the last 20 hours; move key rotation to shared automation with expiry alerts. Escalate if symptoms persist 30 minutes after step completion.
